_comment: Typed envelope for hooks/dispatcher.sh. Keys are Claude Code hook event names. Each entry's tool_pattern is an ERE matched against the invocation's .tool_name (null = matches unconditionally, used for Stop which has no matcher). scripts are hooks/*.sh basenames, run in listed order, each fed the SAME stdin the dispatcher received. tests/test_hooks_dispatch_reachable.py asserts every hooks/*.sh file (other than dispatcher.sh itself) appears in some scripts[] here -- that is the CI gate for '11th hook wired outside the table'.
